data.headline: Asset managers turn net short Dow futures
data.summary: Asset managers moved from 2,080 contracts net long in Dow futures on November 10 to 7,708 net short on November 17. Leveraged funds added to a smaller position on the long side.

bull.text: Leveraged funds increased their net long from 1,315 to 3,449 contracts. Both readings were positive.

bear.text: Asset managers’ weekly shift amounted to 9,788 contracts toward the short side, taking their net exposure below zero.

watch.text: Dow futures open interest changed little, from 83,148 to 83,431 contracts. The next positioning release will show whether the shift persists with a similar number of outstanding contracts.

limitations: The CFTC report covers Dow futures positions as of Tuesday. It provides no direct measure of DIA creations, Friday’s ex-distribution price change or current dealer gamma.

sources.title: CFTC · DJIA x $5 - CHICAGO BOARD OF TRADE · 2026-11-17
